# Webhooks

Create, list, update and delete webhooks.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Runs and events](../../../concepts/runs-and-events.md#3-get-called-back-webhooks).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`WebHookCreate`](#webhookcreate) | Registers a web hook: a URL that Maitento calls whenever something of one kind changes, such as an app run. |
| [`WebHookDelete`](#webhookdelete) | Deletes a web hook. |
| [`WebHookList`](#webhooklist) | Lists the tenant's web hooks. |
| [`WebHookUpdate`](#webhookupdate) | Changes a web hook's URL and secret. |

### WebHookCreate

Registers a web hook: a URL that Maitento calls whenever something of one kind changes, such as an app run.

```c
jsonObject WebHookCreate(string type, string url, string secret)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | What it reports on, such as `AppProcess`. |
| `url` | `string` | The URL to call, such as `https://example.com/maitento/webhook`. |
| `secret` | `string`, can be empty | A secret of your choosing that every call is signed with. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The web hook, as JSON, without its secret: `id`, `type`, `url`, `signedOnly` (`true`), `headers` (empty), `tenantId`, `dateCreated` and `dateUpdated`.

`type` is one of `AppProcess`, `InteractionProcess`, `CapsuleProcess` (sandbox runs), `CodePipelineProcess`, `IngestedFile` (files uploaded to a knowledge base, as they are processed) and `Billing`, in any case. A web hook reports on every change of its type in the tenant, not only those of the app that registered it.

The URL must be an absolute `http` or `https` address on the public internet, not one of Maitento's own hosts and without a user name or password. A tenant has one web hook per URL and type: another fails with `WebHook with URL '<url>' and type '<type>' already exists`. An unknown type fails with `Invalid webhook type '<type>'`.

Every call is signed with the secret: `X-MT-WebHook-Signature` is an HMAC-SHA256 of `X-MT-WebHook-Timestamp` and the body, so your endpoint can check that the call came from Maitento. Always pass a secret: a web hook without one can't sign its calls, so none of them is sent. The secret is write-only, and never returned.

### WebHookDelete

Deletes a web hook.

```c
void WebHookDelete(string id)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The web hook's id, from [`WebHookCreate`](#webhookcreate) or [`WebHookList`](#webhooklist). |

Fails with `Invalid WebHook ID format: <id>` for text that isn't an id, and `Not found` when the tenant has no such web hook.

### WebHookList

Lists the tenant's web hooks.

```c
jsonArray WebHookList()
```

**Returns** `jsonArray`: The web hooks, sorted by type and then URL, as a JSON array, each with the fields [`WebHookCreate`](#webhookcreate) returns. Extra headers are listed by name, each value shown as `********`, and secrets are never included.

### WebHookUpdate

Changes a web hook's URL and secret.

```c
jsonObject WebHookUpdate(string id, string url, string secret)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The web hook's id. |
| `url` | `string` | The URL to call from now on: the current one to keep it. |
| `secret` | `string`, can be empty | The secret to sign calls with from now on. Pass it even when it hasn't changed. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The web hook, as JSON, with the fields [`WebHookCreate`](#webhookcreate) returns.

Pass the secret every time, even when only the URL changes: whatever `secret` holds becomes the web hook's secret, and empty text leaves it with none, so none of its calls is sent.

An update from Cogniscript also removes any extra HTTP headers the web hook was registered with; set them again through the API. The type can't change: delete the web hook and create another.

The URL follows the rules of [`WebHookCreate`](#webhookcreate). Fails with `Invalid WebHook ID format: <id>` for text that isn't an id, and `Not found` when the tenant has no such web hook.
